## Relevant Symbols
- `hooks/speckit-helper.sh:247-252` — `check-tasks-inputs`: the predicate shape to mirror (string + exit code; no-spec refused first).
- `hooks/speckit-helper.sh:253-257` — `check-artifacts`: always exit 0, prints FOUND/MISSING; also called by `commands/hef.review.md:24` and `commands/hef.verify.md:24`, so it must not change.
- `hooks/speckit-helper.sh:51` — the spec-root dispatch list; an arm missing from it answers from the cwd, not the spec root (HEF-1 FR-007 precedent).
- `tests/smoke.sh:2516` — `dc_subs` counts simple case arms (`^  name)`), so a new arm moves the doc count 47 → 48.
- `tests/smoke.sh:780-790` — the invocation runner executes every helper line in `commands/` in a scratch repo with no `.specify/`; a non-zero exit is tolerated, only 126/127 and `Unknown command:` fail — so the new pre-flight line is covered once the arm exists.
- `workflows/workflow.js:286` — tells task agents to read `plan.md`; the `hefesto:workflow` route is out of this item's scope (spec "Deferred").

## Existing Patterns & Conventions
- Predicates answer on stdout with `<TOKEN>: <branch>` and use the exit code as the verdict (`hooks/speckit-helper.sh:231-252`, constitution 5).
- Smoke predicate cases: scratch repo with `git checkout -b feature/<name>`, exact-string + exit-code assertions, each `bad` naming the FR (`tests/smoke.sh:535-554`).
- `grep` straight on a file, never through a pipe under pipefail (`tests/smoke.sh:568-569` comment; constitution 3).
- Command docs gate optional fetches inside the branch that needs them, not in Pre-Flight (`commands/hef.tasks.md:36-43`, HEF-1 review change 2).
